_comment: Themes describe the five inspirations. Each named Keeper has an individual personality, script and ElevenLabs cast entry. Floor lists are in patrol scene order, with conversation partners last on floors 2–4. Level 5 lists all possible wave and boss reinforcements.

lines.text: Listen to this one. 'For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son...'
Only begotten. So he only had the one?
'...that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.' John 3:16.
Everlasting life. Up here that's just an everlasting night shift.
Hush. Somebody in this tower should still believe in something.
Then I believe the bell rings at six. Wake me when it does.
Amen. Now, did anyone remember the service port password? I'm locked out again.
Root. All lowercase. R, O, O, T. Same as every other shift.
Right. Once you're in, you can switch the corridor camera off. Not that I'd ever tell a prisoner.
I'll watch the stairs. And please, don't leave the port open.

Judas.personality: petty racketeer guarding his side business
Judas.alert: Back in your cell. We had a deal.
Judas.body: Who saw this? Tell me who saw.
idle: I don't run a charity. The rate went up.
Keep the key in the inside pocket. Trust nobody.

Rowan.alert: Time out! You're not supposed to be playing!
Rowan.body: Come on. Say I lose. Say something.
idle: Four laps. If I beat my record I get absolutely nothing.
I'll race my shadow. It cheats on the corners.

Ivo.alert: Prisoner out of bounds. Stop at the next line.
Ivo.body: Mark the time. Nobody move the body.
idle: Same boot prints as yesterday. Different direction.
A clean report starts with the things you can't explain.

Bram.personality: trusts signs more than his own eyes
Bram.alert: The sign says stay inside. That's you, right?
Bram.body: It says sleeping quarters upstairs. This can't be right.
idle: The arrow points down, but someone hung it upside down.
I'd read the handbook if I knew which end to start.

Alden.personality: worries about patients under his care
Alden.alert: Stop there. Are you hurt, or are you running?
Alden.body: Get a cloth. No, a clean one. Hurry.
idle: Three beds on the transfer sheet. Only two blankets.
I should have asked where they took the coughing one.

Corin.personality: turns chores into bad stage magic
Corin.alert: And for my next trick... wait, where did you come from?
Corin.body: That's blood. I can't make that disappear.
idle: Coin in this hand. No, the other hand. Ruined it again.
The trick is to look at the audience. The rats never look back.

Dane.personality: takes spotless equipment as a moral duty
Dane.alert: Hands off the rail. Face the wall.
Dane.body: Seal the corridor. I don't want a boot through this scene.
idle: Rust starts where you stop looking.
Someone used my polishing rag to wipe a plate.

Ellis.personality: quiet labor organizer with a dry wit
Ellis.alert: I'd let it slide, but that's how they dock my pay.
Ellis.body: He was owed two weeks. Someone needs to tell his family.
idle: The uniform is free. They take it out of your pay.
If we're all essential, how come none of us gets a chair?

Garrow.alert: Hold on. Do I blow the whistle before I shout?
Garrow.body: Don't touch him. Unless the rule says touch him first.
idle: No running on wet stairs. What about running up them?
Fire drill on Thursday. Hope the fire knows.

Hollis.personality: homesick and protective of small comforts
Hollis.alert: Stop. Please don't make me raise the alarm.
Hollis.body: He had a letter in his pocket. It never got sent.
idle: If I close my eyes this smells almost like home. Almost.
I forgot what bread sounds like when you cut the crust.

Jory.personality: keeps score of the tower's minor absurdities
Jory.alert: An escape. That's a new square on my card.
Jory.body: No. Cross that one off. I never wanted to see it.
idle: Leak in the laundry, rat in the oats. Two more and I win.
My prize for a perfect shift is another shift.

Kell.personality: old drill instructor counting everyone's cadence
Kell.alert: Heel down. Face front. That's an order.
Kell.body: One down. Form up before we lose another.
idle: Left, right. If the floor can keep time, so can you.
One more step out of time and I'll march the stairs myself.

Lusk.personality: desperate to impress with tall stories
Lusk.alert: I caught three like you last week! Wait up!
Lusk.body: I said I'd keep him safe. I really said that.
idle: The beast was this big. Bigger when I tell it upstairs.
I could make captain if they'd just ask about my record.

Marek.personality: sees the tower as his ship to keep watertight
Marek.alert: Breach on this deck. Stand fast.
Marek.body: Close both ends of the passage. Nobody else goes down.
idle: Every door is a bulkhead if you do your job.
I miss a floor that moves for a reason.

Oren.personality: compulsively gives every inconvenience a title
Oren.alert: And now, the escape artist. Hold the applause.
Oren.body: No clever title for this one. Somebody get help.
idle: A study in wet socks, by Keeper Oren.
Portrait of a man waiting for a bell that hates him.

Pavel.personality: literal-minded technician who checks his work twice
Pavel.alert: Unscheduled movement. Show me your pass.
Pavel.body: This wasn't a fall. Look at the angle.
idle: If the latch needs a kick, the latch is broken.
I put the good screws in a separate tin. Someone mixed them.

Silas.alert: Visitors go the other way. Actually, stay right there.
Silas.body: I show people this landing. I can't show them this.
idle: On your left, the tower's second most disappointing window.
Questions at the end, please. There is no end.

Teodor.personality: overthinks simple choices until he freezes
Teodor.alert: Right. Stop. Or should I get someone? Stop anyway.
Teodor.body: I can't decide who to call. Somebody decide for me.
idle: If I start with the bottom step, I won't get the top one wrong.
I've been weighing lunch since breakfast.

Ansel.personality: secretly ashamed of an old lapse in discipline
Ansel.alert: Stop. I won't let it happen on my watch again.
Ansel.body: Not again. I was here this time. I was right here.
idle: I wrote the report twice. Neither version said why I left.
I don't trade shifts. I don't owe anyone another favor.

Brin.personality: buries fear under cheerful bad omens
Brin.alert: I knew the creaking stair meant trouble. Halt!
Brin.body: I joked about bad luck. I didn't mean this.
idle: A bird hit the window. Probably wants a transfer.
If the candle goes out, that's my excuse to go home.

Cato.alert: Step away from the shelves. Let me see your hands.
Cato.body: I know him. He let me finish the chapter.
idle: The best books have the dullest labels.
If I file it under inventory, nobody opens it.

Dov.personality: treats password duty like an embarrassing performance
Dov.alert: You're not on the list. Please don't ask to see it.
Dov.body: I can't joke my way past this. Get the captain.
idle: I practiced saying access denied in the mirror.
The terminal doesn't laugh either. That's reassuring.

Tomas.personality: cannot unsee the human cost of the ward
Tomas.alert: Stay out of the ward. That's for your sake too.
Tomas.body: Get the medic. Don't let them put him on the list.
idle: Names go in the ledger. Numbers come back out.
The worst part is how quiet the doors are.

Ulric.personality: runs rounds like inspection of a failing fortress
Ulric.alert: Intruder in the ward. Keep the exits sealed.
Ulric.body: First secure the door. Then we'll count our own.
idle: The lock is only as good as the Keeper checking it.
I listen for the click. Other people just pull the handle.

Venn.personality: tries to befriend the wards' machinery
Venn.alert: That wasn't the pipes. Hey, you there!
Venn.body: Wake up. Even the boiler makes more noise than you.
idle: Morning, valve three. You sound dreadful today.
One knock means steam. Two knocks means Venn needs lunch.

Wren.personality: soft-spoken gallows humor about medical bureaucracy
Wren.alert: Escaping without a discharge form? Stop right there.
Wren.body: He won't need a discharge form. Someone get a doctor.
idle: They sent me three forms and one bandage.
The medicine cabinet has more locks than medicine.

Edric.personality: earnestly mistakes technical jargon for ordinary words
Edric.alert: The door is under observation. Wait, so are you!
Edric.body: Is this what the records meant by critical? Help!
idle: It says isolate the chamber. I haven't spoken to it all day.
I was told to take inventory. Nobody said where to take it.

Fane.personality: careful pragmatist checking supplies for a disaster
Fane.alert: Stop at the red stripe. Nothing crosses it.
Fane.body: Find the first aid tin. I checked it this morning.
idle: Two lanterns work. Which means we have one spare.
If the water stops, open the barrel before the taps run dry.

Gil.personality: distracts himself by composing awful songs
Gil.alert: I had a rhyme for that. Never mind. Stop!
Gil.body: No song for this. Go get someone.
idle: Ward door, stone floor. That's not enough for a chorus.
Someone told me to sing under my breath. I'm trying.

Hask.personality: insists on a clean handover even in a crisis
Hask.alert: Hold position. State your name and destination.
Hask.body: Mark his post uncovered. I'll take it until relief.
idle: I brief the next shift even when it's the same shift.
Don't say all clear unless you've looked.

Ivar.personality: collects cruel sayings but goes gentle under pressure
Ivar.alert: Well, you're the first interesting thing all night. Halt.
Ivar.body: Easy now. I'll stay with you. Somebody fetch help.
idle: I keep a list of things worse than this job. It's short.
They say the lower you go, the closer you are to promotion.

Yorick.personality: grim veteran expecting the foundation to fail
Yorick.alert: Against the wall. Not the one that's cracking.
Yorick.body: Get away from the stonework. I need a clear path.
idle: You hear that? The whole tower settling on our heads.
I keep one boot pointed at the exit.

Zane.personality: reckless optimist who volunteers before thinking
Zane.alert: I'll get him! Wait, which way did he go?
Zane.body: I said follow me. I shouldn't have said that.
idle: I volunteered for the basement. What a tremendous decision.
Bet I can make it back before anybody notices I left.

Arlen.personality: fixated on keeping his squad alive
Arlen.alert: Don't push your luck. Set it down and back away.
Arlen.body: Cover me. I'm going to bring him out.
idle: Know the person behind you. That's who brings you home.
I count heads at the top and the bottom.

Beck.alert: The doctor's expecting you. I'm not letting you pass.
Beck.body: Where's the doctor when it's one of us?
idle: He said this post was quiet. Maybe he meant afterward.
When the boss whispers, the rest of us run.

Cass.personality: well-meaning recruit who confuses left and right
Cass.alert: Over there! I mean here! Don't move!
Cass.body: I went the wrong way. I should have been here.
idle: Tie a string to the left glove. Now where's the string?
They told me to cover the rear. Rear of what?

Doran.personality: resentful former quartermaster who thinks in shortages
Doran.alert: Stay put. I'm not wasting a second round.
Doran.body: We're short a Keeper. Close ranks and make it count.
idle: They issue one spare for everything except people.
If anyone asks, there were six rounds in that box.

Elm.personality: nervous scavenger making treasures from scrap
Elm.alert: Drop it! I mean stop! I wasn't taking anything.
Elm.body: I found his badge. I didn't think I'd find him too.
idle: This copper will make a good ring if I can bend it.
Don't throw away a good spring just because it's sprung.

Fenn.personality: patiently reads structural faults by sound
Fenn.alert: Footsteps. Stop before you cross that beam.
Fenn.body: I heard a body fall. It wasn't the ceiling.
idle: A dry crack is stone. A wet one means get out.
The little sounds matter before the big ones start.

Pike.personality: quiet believer who reads scripture to exhausted peers
Pike.alert: Peace. Put that down and nobody needs to bleed.
Pike.body: Rest now. I'll stay until they come.
idle: Read it slowly. You miss the good part if you rush.
A bell can call you to more than a shift.

Moss.personality: earnest literalist who turns theology into practical questions
Moss.alert: Are you looking for the stairs? Wait, that's a weapon.
Moss.body: Is he hurt? I can fetch someone. Who do I fetch?
idle: If we all share the bread, does the last man get the crust?
I can remember the verse if I remember what's for lunch.

Tibb.personality: tired skeptic who teases the people he cares for
Tibb.alert: You picked a rotten time for a visit. Stop.
Tibb.body: Come on, friend. I won't laugh if you get up.
idle: If heaven has a night shift, they can keep my place.
I tease Pike because he keeps reading anyway.

Hale.personality: overzealous tracker who treats evidence as personal
Hale.alert: Those prints were yours. End of the trail.
Hale.body: This is his work. Nobody touch the ground around him.
idle: Fresh dust on the hinge. Someone went through.
I don't need a face if I've got a trail.

Rusk.personality: competitive checkpoint investigator eager for a clean arrest
Rusk.alert: Caught you between posts. On your knees.
Rusk.body: He slipped a checkpoint. Tighten the next one.
idle: If I get the arrest, I get out of booth duty.
The trick is to wait where a runner stops to breathe.

Soren.personality: fearful ward reinforcement hiding behind procedure
Soren.alert: Stop there. I have orders to fire this time.
Soren.body: They said there'd be two of us. What do I do now?
idle: Read the order again. My hands won't stop shaking.
They didn't tell me what he looked like until they shut the gate.

Gideon.personality: patient marksman who dislikes close quarters
Gideon.alert: Don't close the distance. Hands where I see them.
Gideon.body: Move to cover. He didn't have a clear lane.
idle: Long hall, straight shot. If I can get my hands still.
Someone keeps putting crates in the firing lanes.

Fenwick.personality: sour reservist who records every unpaid hour
Fenwick.body: That's his last shift. At least write down when it ended.
idle: I write the hours on my cuff. The ledger lies.
Don't call it voluntary if they lock the door behind us.

Osric.personality: young formalist who quotes regulations under stress
Osric.alert: By order of the tower, you will stop. Now!
Osric.body: Section nine. The one about casualties. I can't remember it.
idle: Learn the rule before you need to break it.
They never put the hard cases on the exam.

Leif.personality: former carpenter sizing up exits and repairs
Leif.alert: Stay there. I've got the only clear way out.
Leif.body: He's pinned. Bring a bar, not a gun.
idle: Whoever framed this door didn't own a square.
I could fix the stair if they gave me a saw worth using.

Quill.personality: dry clerk drafted out of the records office
Quill.alert: First the paperwork, then the escape. Stop.
Quill.body: I know his handwriting. I don't want this to be his last entry.
idle: They swapped my pen for a pistol. The pen jammed less.
If I get out of this, I'm filing one very long complaint.

Nash.personality: superstitious runner listening for warnings in echoes
Nash.alert: I heard you before I saw you. Don't move.
Nash.body: The echo stopped. Get somebody down here.
idle: Never answer the second echo. It isn't yours.
I count four footsteps when there should be three.

Bastian.personality: brooding brawler wary of enclosed spaces
Bastian.alert: Come out where I can see you. Slowly.
Bastian.body: Get the doors open. I need room to move him.
idle: If the ceiling gets any lower, I'm taking the stairs.
I can fight a man. I can't fight a locked room.

Reeve.personality: exasperated relief guard with a strong sense of duty
Reeve.alert: You can wait. I've been waiting all night.
Reeve.body: He was waiting for me to relieve him. I came too late.
idle: I had my boots off when they rang the bell.
An extra shift is fine. It's the missing sleep I mind.

Seth.personality: quiet messenger trying to avoid being noticed
Seth.alert: I don't want a fight. Just stop there.
Seth.body: I'll get help. Someone stay with him.
idle: Deliver the order and walk away. That's all I have to do.
I prefer notes. Nobody asks a note why it's shaking.

Vale.personality: vain new officer afraid of losing command
Vale.alert: Eyes on me, prisoner. On me!
Vale.body: Look at me. Listen to me. We can still save him.
idle: Nobody remembers your orders if you say them quietly.
I learned to shout before I learned what to say.

Tarin.personality: a former stair runner who counts the quickest routes
Tarin.alert: Cut him off at the next landing.
Tarin.body: I can reach the medic from here. Keep the stair clear.
idle: The east stairs are faster if the door is open.
Thirty steps. Thirty-one if I miss the turn.

Ewan.personality: a reluctant reserve who thinks every alarm is a drill
Ewan.alert: All right, good drill. Wait, this is real!
Ewan.body: This is real. Get someone down here.
idle: I put my boots on for this. It had better be a drill.
Do they grade you on how fast you get to the wrong landing?

Niall.personality: a checkpoint reserve who treats every search as a lockdown
Niall.alert: No one leaves this corridor. Halt!
Niall.body: Seal the passage. Send a runner for help.
idle: If the watcher blinks twice, I check both doors.
A blind post is still a post. I stand it.

Ames.personality: a reserve who jokes about interrupted meals until things turn serious
Ames.alert: You could have waited till I finished my supper. Stop!
Ames.body: Forget supper. Somebody get a doctor.
idle: I bring cold soup. It saves the tower the trouble.
The watcher always sees someone when I sit down.

Mott.alert: Down here? Nobody comes down here. Except you, apparently.
Mott.body: Bram? Bram, get up. This isn't funny.
idle: Bottom floor, bottom pay. Story of my life.
If that support cracks, I'm not the one explaining it.
Mott.personality: resents being stationed at the bottom

Pell.alert: Back in your cell! I said back!
Pell.body: He was coughing yesterday. Now he's not doing anything.
idle: Another door, another cough. I stopped counting.
They say it doesn't spread to us. They say a lot.
Pell.personality: tired of pretending the sick are dangerous

Crane.alert: Wrong floor, prisoner. Wrong life, too.
Crane.body: Somebody's going to make me write this up.
idle: I polish this floor and it just gets dirtier.
Nobody visits the vault. That's the appeal.
Crane.personality: takes pride in a floor nobody sees

Stroud.alert: You! Don't make me run, my knee's gone!
Stroud.body: Oh, wonderful. Another one for the cart.
idle: Forty years and they still won't fix these stairs.
My knee says rain. My knee is always right.
Stroud.personality: blames everything on his bad knee

Thane.alert: Halt! Halt, I think that's the word!
Thane.body: Is he asleep? Tell me he's asleep.
idle: First week. Nobody told me about the coughing.
If I stand very still maybe they'll forget I'm here.
Thane.personality: new recruit terrified of being noticed

Holt.alert: There you are. I bet Mott you'd come this way.
Holt.body: That's a week's wages I'm never collecting.
idle: Two to one says the lamp goes out by midnight.
I'd bet on the rats, honestly.

Wick.alert: Get back in line! All of you, in line!
Wick.body: Nobody touches him. Nobody touches anything.
idle: Gloves on. Gloves off. Gloves on again.
Wash your hands. I said wash them.

Garth.alert: Oi! Visiting hours ended years ago!
Garth.body: That's two this week. I'm keeping count.
idle: Cell nine asked for water again. Cell nine can wait.
I used to know their names.

Rook.alert: Up here? Clever. Not clever enough.
Rook.body: Nobody falls off a ledge that quietly.
idle: Best view in the tower. Worst pay.
They told me nobody climbs up here. So why am I up here?

Rhea.alert: Intruder! Hold the pose, I mean, hold still!
Rhea.body: Oh no. Oh no, I should've stretched him out first.
idle: Roll the shoulders, long exhale. Even down here, breathe.
Twelve hours standing. My core has never been stronger.

Marta.alert: Hey! Put that down, you'll ruin my sourdough! I mean, stop!
Marta.body: Somebody help him! Somebody get the first aid, and the flour!
idle: Starter needs feeding at six. The tower never lets me go home on time.
Cinnamon rolls on my day off. Ten tower guards, ten rolls.
Marta.personality: bakes in her head all shift

Odette.alert: Stop! You're the most interesting thing that's happened to me all year!
Odette.body: Of course. Even the dead ones stop to talk to me.
idle: Four years on this floor and not one man who reads.
Maybe the next prisoner will be handsome. A girl can dream.
Odette.personality: lonely and desperate to meet someone

Sunniva.alert: Not now! Eleven days left on my contract. Eleven!
Sunniva.body: Nope. Not signing the incident report. Eleven days.
idle: Eleven days. Then a goat farm in the north. Goats don't ask for passwords.
I've already named the goats. Don't laugh.
Sunniva.personality: counts the days to the end of her contract

Calla.alert: Oh my, a real runaway! This is going straight into my podcast!
Calla.body: Okay, that's one for the true crime episode.
idle: Episode forty. The case of the missing lunch money. Unsolved.
Everyone here has a motive. Everyone. Even Garrow.

Ingrid.alert: Intruder in the stacks! Quiet, please! Quiet!
Ingrid.body: Overdue. Everything about this is overdue.
idle: Keeper regulations, section nine, subsection four. Nobody ever reads it.
Alphabetical. Chronological. Then by whom I like less.
Ingrid.personality: treats the tower like a library she runs

Noor.alert: Well, well. Look who's out past curfew. Shame about the handcuffs.
Noor.body: Aw. And I'd just gotten used to the company.
idle: The night shift is long and the only company is Garth. Garth!
I wore the good boots today and nobody even looked.
Noor.personality: bored and flirts with everyone, even prisoners

Dara.alert: Records are off limits! Step away from the screen!
Dara.body: Dara's down. Somebody tell the desk, they'll want the keys.
idle: The screen hums at night. I've started humming back.
Nobody reads the old files. That's the only reason I guard them.
Dara.personality: guards the records like they were his own diary

Vesna.alert: Hands off the port! That's maintenance property!
Vesna.body: Oh no. And I just got the port working.
idle: Root, root. If anyone asks, I never said that.
Two cables, one spare. That's my whole job.
Vesna.personality: proud of a job nobody understands

Ilse.body: Not at my terminal. Not on my shift.
idle: I clean the screen every shift. No one notices.
If the screen flickers, it's the ghost. I don't believe in ghosts.

Bryn.alert: Hey! That terminal is logged, you know!
Bryn.body: I had one job: watch the screen.
idle: Every login is logged. Even mine.
I've read the whole nine-page manual. Twice.

Odell.body: Nobody warned me about this posting.
idle: Third floor smells like paper and bleach.
I log everyone who sits down. Except the dead ones.
Odell.personality: keeps a tally of who sits at the terminal

Corra.alert: Away from the checkpoint terminal! Now!
Corra.body: Somebody's going to have to explain this to the captain.
idle: Checkpoint duty is the quietest post in the tower.
If the cameras fail, I'm the backup. Lucky me.

Wren2.body: This is why I asked for a transfer.
idle: Ward files. Ward files. Ward files.
I read the first line of a record once. Never again.
Wren2.personality: afraid of what the records say

Fenna.body: Fenna's down. The file stays closed.
idle: The sick ward files are the worst to guard.
I memorise each log. It helps the night pass.

Marl.alert: That log is classified! Stand down!
Marl.body: Not like this. Not by the terminal.
idle: Observation logs have the best handwriting.
I read the cover pages and pretend I understand.

Pru.body: Pru? Somebody get the nurse, now!
idle: I keep the ward terminal warm for the doctor.
Nobody loves the ward terminal like I do.
Pru.personality: fond of the ward terminal like a pet

Garrick.body: Garrick down at the foundation! Send the doctor!
idle: Everything above rests on this terminal. I keep it that way.
Twenty years on the lowest floor. The roof has never fallen. Yet.
Garrick.personality: a gruff foundation veteran who guards the last terminal like a bridge
